The '''''Stygian Talon''''' was a [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptor]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.9}}</ref>

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Stygian Talon'' first appeared in Game Update 7.9: ''Legacy Reborn'', released on [[June 2]], [[2026]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Release">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20260602-0|text=Game Update 7.9 "Legacy Reborn" is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>

In the mission "The First Hurdle," if the player is affiliated with the Sith Empire, [[Darth Krovos]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]] will use the ship during the [[Battle of Khar Shian]].<ref name="The First Hurdle" />
